# Rekordly

> Rekordly is a free, source-available Windows desktop app that monitors
> content creators, automatically records their live streams, downloads
> videos and VODs, and organizes everything into a searchable local library.

Rekordly watches the creators you follow across supported streaming sites,
hits record the moment they go live, and files every capture into a
searchable local library. Recording is a lossless straight copy powered by
bundled yt-dlp and ffmpeg — nothing else to install. The app is local-first:
no account, no telemetry, all data stays in SQLite on your machine. Free for
personal, educational, and other noncommercial use under the PolyForm
Noncommercial License 1.0.0; Pro is a one-time payment that removes
live-recording limits; commercial use requires a separate license.

Supported platforms: Chaturbate, Stripchat, BongaCams, CamSoda, MyFreeCams,
Twitch, and YouTube — extensible to any site through the community plugin
system and its typed SDK.

- [Pricing](https://rekordly.in/pricing): free tier, $29 one-time Pro license, commercial licensing
- [Plugins](https://rekordly.in/plugins): the plugin system and how to build a site plugin
- [Blog](https://rekordly.in/blog): guides and product notes
- [Roadmap](https://rekordly.in/roadmap): shipped, in-progress, and planned work
- [Contact](https://rekordly.in/contact): bug reports, feature requests, and general inquiries

- [Docs home](https://rekordly.in/docs): full documentation index

- [Auto-Record](https://rekordly.in/docs/auto-record): unattended recording with safety rails

- [Plugins reference](https://rekordly.in/docs/plugins): writing site plugins against the SDK
- [Troubleshooting](https://rekordly.in/docs/troubleshooting): crash recovery, disk guardrails, low-resource mode
